jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager- Data Modeling
jobs.description_text: At Aledade, we empower primary care physicians with technology to keep their patients healthy, preventing unnecessary hospitalizations. As the Senior Engineering Manager for our Data Modeling team, you will be a highly technical leader delivering high business impact on projects of increasing dependencies and ambiguity. You will build and empower a high-efficiency team of individual contributors, with a relentless focus on scaling data throughput while maintaining uncompromising data quality. In this role, your team will develop the foundational technology that saves lives and improves mental and physical health for millions of people. You will guide the architectural and operational modeling of complex healthcare domains aligned with FHIR concepts—including claims, encounters, attribution, medications, and clinical status—leveraging tools like DBT, Kafka, Snowflake, Databricks. Bonus Qualifications: While strong engineering leadership is paramount, hands-on expertise with Snowflake, Databricks, and deep healthcare business domain knowledge are strong pluses that will help you accelerate your team's success.

jobs.title: Senior GRC Engineer II
jobs.description_text: As a Sr Security Engineer II on the Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) team, you will play a central role in strengthening and sustaining our cybersecurity posture, policy governance, and regulatory compliance programs. Operating within the Information Security GRC team, you will serve as a primary steward of Aledade’s security policies, policy governance, cyber risk management frameworks, and continuous audit readiness. In this role, you will act as the key liaison and point person for security risk intake, providing expert risk advisory, trade-off analysis, and actionable guidance to cross-functional stakeholders across Engineering, IT, Legal, Product, and Business Operations. You will directly maintain and manage Aledade’s InfoSec issue tracker and risk register, ensuring that security findings, control gaps, and risk mitigations are rigorously documented, assigned, and tracked to closure. Furthermore, you will work closely with your manager to produce and report monthly and quarterly KPIs and metrics for leadership, as well as facilitate key audit and assessment engagements—including SOC 2 Type 2 attestation, SOX ITGC testing, HIPAA/HITRUST reviews, NIST 800-53 assessments, and other internal assessments—ensuring seamless evidence collection, auditor coordination, and continuous compliance across Aledade's healthcare ecosystem.

The Stage Responsible Engineer (Stage RE) develops the fluid systems required to enable higher-performance, highly manufacturable interplanetary vehicles. This role develops the design, operation, and performance of the stage propulsion systems on the Starship launch vehicle. The stage propulsion systems include all propellant feed systems, propellant management systems, helium pressurization systems, pneumatic systems, autogenous pressurization systems, differential pressure measurement systems, engine ignition gas supply systems, environmental control systems, and attitude control systems integrated into each stage of the vehicle. The Stage RE owns overall stage propulsion system performance for each vehicle and mission.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Develop and maintain top-level requirements, system design, operation, and performance of the associated components for the systems above
  • Develop and maintain thermal/fluid models of the stage propulsion systems
  • Generate and maintain stage control system timing, valve sequencing, and stage
